Dear Parents,

Our fourth-grade class will visit the Museum of Natural History on Friday, May 16. The bus leaves at 8:15 and returns by 2:30. Students should bring a packed lunch and a water bottle.

Permission slips are due by Wednesday. Students without a signed slip will not be able to attend, and will spend the day with Mrs. Grant's class.

Their are still two spots for parent chaperones. If your interested, please reply to this email.

Thank you,
Ms. Albright

labels.notes: The comma before "and will spend" is debatable but not flagged.
